[[Nahdat Zemamra|RCA Zemamra]] |matches= 240 |total goals= 540 |prevseason= [[2019–20 Botola|2019–20]] |nextseason= [[2021–22 Botola|2021–22]] |updated = 01 August 2021 }} The '''2020–21 Botola Pro''', also known as '''Botola Pro Inwi''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 64th season of the Premier League and the 10th under its new format of Moroccan Pro League, [[Botola|the top Moroccan professional league]] for [[association football]] clubs, since its establishment in 1956.{{Cite web|url=https://www.frmf.ma/fr/content/histoire-du-football-au-maroc|title=Histoire du Football au Maroc {{!}} الموقع الرسمي للجامعة الملكية المغربية لكرة القدم|website=www.frmf.ma|access-date=2019-08-22}} [[Raja Casablanca]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[2019–20 Botola|2019–20 season]]. [[Chabab Mohammédia]] and [[Maghreb de Fès]] entered as the two promoted teams from the [[2019–20 Botola 2]]. The season began on 4 December 2020 and ended on 28 July 2021.
